name: Gource
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: Animates commit history as a growing tree; writes a PPM frame stream
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said version 0.56 on Homebrew; confirmed, formula 0.56_1 (gource has no --version flag; the banner on --help prints v0.56). Lead's licence GPL-3.0-or-later not re-verified beyond the lead.
2026-11-27: Not headless on macOS: it opens an OpenGL window while writing frames. Observed in a desktop session only.
2026-11-27: Seed option is --hash-seed (colours and hashing); the layout is not repeatable across runs in the fixture.

evidence.result: Partial: custom log to PPM pipe to H.264 works (640x360, 30/1, frame not blank; pass). Frame count 434 to 462 against 58 predicted from seconds-per-day (fail). 4 renders gave 2 to 3 distinct hashes with --hash-seed 1 (fail).
evidence.scope: 24-event custom log, macOS arm64 desktop session with window: route works; frame count off prediction and frames not repeatable across runs; headless not shown

summary: Repository-history visualiser. Reads a VCS directory or a custom pipe-delimited log and renders an animated tree of files and contributors, writing a PPM stream for FFmpeg. Needs an OpenGL window; frames come out in order, not seekable, and are not repeatable run to run.
use_when: A developer-facing film needs a code-history tree shot from a log you author or export
A quick, one-off activity visual where exact repeatability does not matter
avoid_when: Frame-exact repeatable renders or a fixed duration are required: draw the tree with d3 or graphviz

assessment.rationale: Fills a gap no neighbour covers: ready-made code-history video. The fixture shows the route works but frames and duration are not controllable enough for pipeline use; keep as a visual shortcut, not a deterministic renderer.
